AdminShell.adminPanelDescription: Manage organization operations from a single control surface.
AdminShell.pageDashboard: Monitor member services, current requests, and daily activity.
AdminShell.pageMembers: Search and review member records and request history.
AdminShell.pageAnnouncements: Manage published notices, drafts, and pinned updates.
AdminShell.pageRequests: Track incoming document requests and their status changes.
AdminShell.pageServices: Enable or disable member services and maintain their public requirements.
AdminShell.pagePolls: Create official member polls and review vote activity.
AdminShell.pageSchedules: Coordinate recurring services, events, and advisories.
AdminShell.pageEventPosts: Publish post-event recaps so members can catch up with what happened.
AdminShell.pageGallery: Upload and manage organization photos visible to all members.
AdminShell.pageOfficials: Manage organization officials and their term information.
AdminShell.pageEmergencyContacts: Maintain verified hotlines for urgent member needs.

SuperAdminShell.pageDashboard: Platform-wide overview of all registered organizations.
SuperAdminShell.pageOrganizations: Manage registered organizations, their settings, and access.
SuperAdminShell.pageAdminAccounts: Create and manage admin accounts for registered organizations.
SuperAdminShell.pageDeletionRequests: Review and process member account deletion requests.
SuperAdminShell.pageWaitlist: Early access signups from the landing page.
